# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Anthony Pye is a young boy with a dark, sullen little face. He has black eyes, which he uses to stare with a hostile expression.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

Anthony Pye is a rather mischievous character who displays an impertinent swagger. He is prone to whispering and grinning at others during class.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## History

Anthony Pye is an orphan who was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye. After beginning school under [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), he initially held a stubborn dislike for her and caused disruptions, including putting a mouse in her desk. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) whipped him for the prank, Anthony developed a new respect for her and was finally won over as a devoted pupil.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), +124 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--anthony-pye.md)

Anthony Pye is one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's students at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Their relationship is initially strained, culminating in a day when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) whips Anthony for putting a mouse in her desk. Following this severe punishment, Anthony develops a newfound respect for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), ultimately winning him over as a student.

- presumed Student of  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
